messages.author: 42ea5b005ab9f169
messages.subject: Nothing working - deployApp() terminateApp()
parts:
Hi,

As of last night nothing is working for me.

Last night I successfully deployed 2 apps. Then later tried to update one of them. deployApp() failed with a server timeout error. I can't reproduce it this morning but it was something like:

 `_nginx server timeout` 

I then tried terminateApp() which also failed with the same error.

I tried again this morning and deployApp() got as far as:

`deploying: Deploying 1 instance(s)`

Then just stopped. After 30 mins or so I interrupted the R process and tried again. Now terminateApp() and depolyApp() both fail with the following error, also the App no longer loads through the shiny.io URL:

`Error: /v1/applications/13081/deploy 409 - Unable to deploy application-13081: 1 tasks in progress.`

Which I guess is caused by interrupting during the deployment process. I then tried making a new copy of the app with a new name and deploying again. It has been over 30 mins and the process is still stuck at:

`deploying: Deploying 1 instance(s)`

I think there are a lot of users from Coursera who all need to get an app deployed before tomorrow night for an assignment deadline so any and all suggestions are very welcome.

Thanks

Robin
